name: const unsafe fn transmute < Src , Dst > (src : Src) -> Dst
rule: A pointer constructed by transmuting an integer must not be used for non-zero-sized memory accesses. This also applies when the integer is nested inside an array, tuple, struct, or enum; MaybeUninit<usize> is not considered an integer for this restriction.
api: const unsafe fn transmute < Src , Dst > (src : Src) -> Dst
